PARAMS = {
    "W1":  (3.2,    1.5,   8.0),     # input nfet W (L=1); refine so I1(vin=0.75) ~ Ip - vout/RL
    "W2":  (6.0,    2.0,   20.0),    # nfet cascode W (L=0.5)
    "Wp":  (11.2,   6.0,   20.0),    # pfet load W (L=1), mirror ratio Wp/Wpd sets Ip
    "Wp2": (12.0,   4.0,   30.0),    # pfet cascode W (L=0.5)
    "RL":  (3.3e6,  1.5e6, 8e6),     # output shunt: sets Rout -> gain and f3db
    "Rb":  (30e3,   15e3,  60e3),    # NMOS cascode gate = Vgs0 + Iref*Rb
    "Rp":  (60e3,   30e3,  120e3),   # PMOS cascode gate = pg - Ib*Rp
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    vin = spec.get("vin_dc", 0.75)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    W0, Wb, Wpd = 2.0, 1.0, 4.0     # reference nfet, bias-mirror nfet (Ib = Iref/2), pfet diode
    L1, Lc, Lp = 1.0, 0.5, 1.0
    W1, W2, Wp, Wp2 = p["W1"], p["W2"], p["Wp"], p["Wp2"]
    RL, Rb, Rp = p["RL"], p["Rb"], p["Rp"]

    def solve_vgs(dev, W, L, I, vds=None, vsb=0.0):
        lo, hi = 0.2, 1.6
        for _ in range(50):
            m = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
            o = lut.op(dev, W, L, m, vds if vds is not None else m, vsb)
            if o["Id"] < I:
                lo = m
            else:
                hi = m
        return 0.5 * (lo + hi)

    # Reference branch and bias currents
    vgs0 = solve_vgs("n", W0, L1, iref)
    ncas = vgs0 + iref * Rb
    pcas = 0.45
    ib = 5e-6
    for _ in range(3):
        ib = lut.op("n", Wb, L1, vgs0, max(pcas, 0.1))["Id"]
        vsgp = solve_vgs("p", Wpd, Lp, ib)
        pg = vdd - vsgp
        pcas = pg - ib * Rp
    # Load and input currents (internal cascode nodes estimated)
    vsd1 = 0.25
    vs2 = 0.3
    for _ in range(4):
        opp = lut.op("p", Wp, Lp, vsgp, vsd1)
        ip = opp["Id"]
        vsg2 = solve_vgs("p", Wp2, Lc, ip, vds=0.4, vsb=vsd1)
        vsd1 = max(vdd - (pcas + vsg2), 0.05)
        vgs2 = solve_vgs("n", W2, Lc, ip, vds=0.4, vsb=vs2)
        vs2 = max(ncas - vgs2, 0.05)
    op1 = lut.op("n", W1, L1, vin, vs2)
    i1 = op1["Id"]
    op2 = lut.op("n", W2, Lc, vgs2, 0.4, vs2)
    opp2 = lut.op("p", Wp2, Lc, vsg2, 0.4, vsd1)

    # Small-signal analysis
    gm1, gds1 = op1["gm"], op1["gds"]
    rn = (op2["gm"] + 1e-12) / (op2["gds"] + 1e-15) / (gds1 + 1e-15)
    rp = (opp2["gm"] + 1e-12) / (opp2["gds"] + 1e-15) / (opp["gds"] + 1e-15)
    rout = 1.0 / (1.0 / RL + 1.0 / rn + 1.0 / rp)
    vout = min(max(rout * (ip - i1) + 0.0, 0.0), vdd)   # KCL with shunt to vss dominating
    cpar = 3e-15 * (W2 * 0.3 + Wp2 * 0.3) + 10e-15
    ctot = cl + cpar
    A = gm1 * rout
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * ctot)
    f3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * rout * ctot)
    vmin = vs2 + 0.15
    vmax = pcas + vsg2 - 0.15
    power = vdd * (iref + ib + ip)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias generation
    n.R("RB", "ibias", "nb", Rb)
    n.M("MN0", "nb", "nb", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W0, L1)
    n.M("MNB", "pcas", "nb", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wb, L1)
    n.M("MPD", "pg", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wpd, Lp)
    n.R("RP", "pg", "pcas", Rp)
    # core: cascoded CS
    n.M("M1", "x", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W1, L1)
    n.M("M2", "vout", "ibias", "x", "vss", "nfet", W2, Lc)
    n.M("MP1", "y", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    n.M("MP2", "vout", "pcas", "y", "vdd", "pfet", Wp2, Lc)
    n.R("RL", "vout", "vss", RL)

    return n, {
        "gain_db": 20 * math.log10(max(A, 1e-9)),
        "f3db": f3,
        "gbw": gbw,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": vout,
        "swing": max(vmax - vmin, 0.0),
    }
